description: Read one iCloud Mail message by uid (from apple_mail_search): headers (from, to, cc, reply-to, date, subject, message-id), the body as plain text (HTML converted to readable text when there is no text part), a truncated flag, and attachment names/types/sizes (no attachment contents). Never marks the message read; to do that, use apple_mail_update_flags with seen:true. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (app-specific password), and ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS unless the Apple ID is an @icloud.com/@me.com/@mac.com address.

mailbox.description: Mailbox holding the message (default inbox); path or alias.

maxChars.description: Most body characters to return (default 20000, max 100000); longer bodies are cut and flagged truncated.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for dates you pass and dates returned (default: DISPLAY_TZ).

uidValidity.description: The mailbox uidValidity returned alongside the uids. When given, the call is refused if the mailbox was renumbered since (an old uid could then name a different message).

name: apple_mail_get_message
title: Read an iCloud Mail message
